kebab_example: aliyun agency issue-coupon-for-customer --coupon-template-id 5075915 --uidlist 111,2222 --accept-language zh-CN --is-use-benefit true --application-reason '为客户XXX审批优惠券，该客户是XXXX' --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IssueCouponForCustomer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the coupon template
parameters.name: coupon_template_id

parameters.help_en: The list of UIDs, separated by commas (,). Example: 111,2222
parameters.help_zh:
uid列表
用,分割 如 111,2222
parameters.name: uidlist

parameters.help_en:
The language parameter. Default value: none. Valid values:
- zh-CN: Chinese.
- en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
多语言参数
 默认值:无
    中文：zh-CN
    英文：en-US
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the POC coupon quota. Valid values:
- true: Uses the POC coupon quota. If all submitted accounts are marked as approval-exempt, the current coupon application skips the approval process, and the POC coupon quota in your partner benefit package is deducted.
- false: Does not use the POC coupon quota. Regardless of the approval-exempt status of the submitted accounts, your POC coupon privilege quota remains unchanged. In this case, the application follows the standard coupon application approval process
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用POC优惠券额度
ture：使用POC优惠券额度，如果所有提交的账号都标记为免审批，则当前的优惠券申请将跳过审批流程，您的伙伴权益包中的POC优惠券配额将被扣除；
false：不使用POC优惠券额度，无论提交账号的免审批状态如何，您的POC优惠券权益配额将保持不变，在这种情况下，申请将遵循标准的优惠券申请审批流程
parameters.name: is_use_benefit

parameters.example: 为客户XXX审批优惠券，该客户是XXXX
parameters.help_zh:

如：为客户XXX申请优惠券
